description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Kenya working-day offset. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this package covers the nationwide public-holiday layer only. It is not a universal private-employer, bank, school, county, sector, diplomatic or shift-work calendar. The Saturday-Sunday baseline is a calculation convention for ordinary weekday work, not a claim that every employer uses the same roster. Idd-ul-Fitr and Idd-ul-Adha are pinned to the 2026 Gazette declarations; future lunar dates and later special notices require a refreshed package. The Act's Sunday substitution rule is preserved and no Saturday-to-Monday substitution is inferred.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts Kenya authority-scope working days in exact coverage.
Example user requests: Add or subtract Kenya working days around Idd-ul-Fitr public holiday. | Add or subtract Kenya working days around Ordinary Kenya working day.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","working_days":0}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement only on status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/kenya-public-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/kenya-public-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_ke_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Kenya 2026 nationwide public-holiday layer over a Saturday-Sunday working-week baseline

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Kenya Working Days
